about.title: About EduAccess
about.description: EduAccess Integral is a learning platform for students with low vision (mild to moderate visual impairment). It uses AI to create lessons from real sources, adapted to each student's level, content type and visual profile, with read-aloud, exercises, described images and groups where teachers publish lessons and track progress.
about.researchDesc: This prototype is part of a doctoral thesis that evaluates a five-service architecture (content aggregation, visual profiling, accessibility remediation, AI orchestration and content delivery) and measures its resilience to AI failures. It builds on Michael (2024), Jeanneret & Baudet (2022), ISO/IEC 24751 and WCAG 2.1 AA.
techItems: React 18 + TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui
Cloud database, accounts and real-time sync
AI for lessons, translations, images and their descriptions
Read-aloud using the device's own voices
Installable app (PWA) for phone and computer
